slides.texte_overlay:
Underrated qualities
that make a man attractive
Patience. With slow waiters, delayed trains, people learning something new. A man who stays calm when things are slow is quietly very attractive.
Reliability. He shows up when he said he would, every time. In a world full of cancelled plans, being dependable stands out more than ever before.
Curiosity. He asks questions, wants to learn, gets excited about new ideas. Curious people are never boring, and they make life feel bigger.
Kindness to strangers. Holding a door, helping someone lost, thanking the cleaner. How a man treats people who can't do anything for him says everything.
A growing mind. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and having something new to share keeps every conversation fresh and alive.
slides.texte_sophia: A growing mind. I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Something new to share keeps conversations alive.

slides.texte_overlay: Emotional honesty. He can say "I'm stressed" or "I was wrong" without drama. That openness makes people feel safe, trusted and close to him.
A sense of humour about himself. He laughs at his own mistakes and doesn't take every comment personally. Lightness is one of the most magnetic traits there is.
